sentences.text: Shri Bhavil Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri Shailesh Khampariya, learned Panel Lawyer for the re State.
Case diary is available With consent, heard finally.

This is first application filed under section 438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.84/2021, registered at Police Station Ishan Nagar, District Chhatarpur for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420/34 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Ishan Nagar, District Chhatarpur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: A s per prosecution story, it is alleged against the applicant that on 23.05.2021, the applicant in connivance with co-accused person with an intention to cheat the Government supplied 91 sacks of substandard wheat through the co-accused Rajesh Yadav.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that as the alleged act comes under the Special Act i.e.
Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, therefore, applicant cannot be enlarged under Indian Penal Code.
Offences und er Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006
As alleged substandard wheat has already been seized, custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required, therefore, the applicant m a y be released on anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the respondent-State has opposed the application for anticipatory bail.

Having regard the facts & circumstances of the case and the allegations made against the applicant,
this Court is of the considered opinion that it is a Signature Not SAN Verified fit case for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
Hence, without 2 MCRC-38386-2021 expressing any opinion on merits of the matter, this application is allowed.

A s per prosecution story, it is alleged against the applicant that on 23.05.2021, the applicant in connivance with co-accused person with an intention to cheat the Government supplied 91 sacks of substandard wheat through the co-accused Rajesh Yadav.
